artists.biography:
Baxter Dury (born 18 December 1971, Wingrave, Buckinghamshire, England) is an English indie musician, currently signed to Rough Trade Records. He is the son of Ian Dury, and as a five-year-old he appeared on the front cover of Ian's LP New Boots and Panties!!. He left school at the age of fourteen. He has had a 'Record of the Week' in NME with Oscar Brown EP in 2002. He has one son, Kosmo Korda Dury (born 2002) whose mother is the granddaughter of Zoltan Korda.
More recently, Dury has signed a new recording contract with Parlophone.

perplexity.description:
Baxter Dury’s sixth studio album, The Night Chancers, was released in 2020 and stands as a distinctive entry in his discography, blending elements of rock and pop with his signature sardonic wit and observational lyricism. Recorded at Hoxa Studios in West Hampstead, the album features co-production by longtime collaborator Craig Silvey, known for his work with Arcade Fire. Musically, The Night Chancers is marked by shuffling basslines, laid-back grooves, and a mix of comedown disco and late-night melancholy, all filtered through Dury’s characteristic blend of seedy realism and affectionate humanity.

The album was met with widespread critical acclaim, earning an average score of 86 on Metacritic based on 13 reviews, and was praised for its sharp songwriting and atmospheric production. It reached the Top 20 on the Scottish Albums Chart and the Top 5 on the UK Independent Albums Chart, reflecting its strong reception among both critics and fans. Released internationally by [PIAS] Le Label and in the UK, Ireland, and USA by Heavenly Recordings, The Night Chancers solidified Baxter Dury’s reputation as a singular voice in British indie rock and pop.
